\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch6:6-11

Suppose $(M, g)$ is a connected Riemannian manifold, $P \subseteq M$ is a connected embedded submanifold, and $\bar{g}$ is the induced Riemannian metric on $P$.

  1. Show that $d_{\bar{g}}(p, q) \geq d_g(p, q)$ for $p, q \in P$.

  2. Prove that if $(M, g)$ is complete and $P$ is closed in $M$, then $(P, \bar{g})$ is complete.

  3. Give an example of a complete Riemannian manifold $(M, g)$ and a connected embedded submanifold $P \subseteq M$ that is complete but not closed in $M$.

\end{exercise}
